seoTitle: Integrate Microsoft Outlook with Zapier (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Connect Outlook to Zapier to automatically sync emails, calendar events, and contacts with thousands of other apps.
intro: Manually copying details out of Outlook into other tools adds friction to your day. This guide shows how to connect Microsoft Outlook to Zapier, choose a trigger like a new email or calendar event, and map key fields into your workflow so your inbox operations run in the background.

steps.heading: Create a new Zap
steps.body: Open the Zapier dashboard and start a new Zap workflow.

steps.heading: Select Outlook as your trigger app
steps.body: Choose Microsoft Outlook and review the available trigger events.

steps.heading: Authenticate your Microsoft account
steps.body: Sign in with your Microsoft 365 credentials and grant the required permissions safely.

steps.heading: Fetch sample data
steps.body: Pull fresh email or calendar sample payloads to confirm the connection is working before mapping fields.

steps.heading: Add an action step
steps.body: Map your collected Outlook fields, such as sender name, subject, or meeting time, into a second app.

steps.heading: Test and publish
steps.body: Run an end-to-end live test and confirm the automated Outlook Zap works before publishing.

faq.question: What Outlook events can trigger a Zap?
faq.answer: You can trigger on events like a new inbound email, a new calendar event, or a new contact created.

faq.question: Does this work with enterprise Microsoft 365 accounts?
faq.answer: Yes, though enterprise accounts may involve additional permission checks, and the tutorial covers troubleshooting connection resets for these cases.

faq.question: What data can I pull from an email trigger?
faq.answer: Dynamic variables like sender name, subject lines, and email body text can be mapped into your workflow.

faq.question: Can I sync calendar meeting times into other apps?
faq.answer: Yes, meeting times from Outlook calendar events can be mapped as data tokens into your action steps.
